summary: Pipe atmos transfer rate is too slow

comments.content:
Build an engine pipe that's really long and place meters all over it. You
can actually watch the gas move from segment to segment - probably at a
rate of one pipe segment per second or so. This has to speed up.

This patchfile changes 2 characters, wooooo

for /unstable but should work for /stable too, increases flowrate from 0.5 to 0.99
(with potentially disasterous results)
